# The compaction fixture (KAR-09.6 AC9)

A real ledger holding **one `context.compacted` of each fidelity**:

| scope           | fidelity  | before | after  | what it proves                                             |
| --------------- | --------- | ------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DeFlow.packet` | `exact`   | measured | measured | DeFlow demoted a body itself and counted both ends       |
| `vendor.session`| `partial` | 167000 | `null` | the vendor reported `pre_tokens` and nothing else          |

It is the fixture the replay harness and EPIC-17's context-budget view are both developed against,
and it is **generated by the production code paths** rather than written by hand:

```
node packages/ledger/scripts/build-compaction-fixture.ts
```

`compactions.json` is the same two payloads in ledger order. It exists because a browser spec cannot
open SQLite, and the alternative — a second hand-maintained copy inside the web package — is exactly
the drift this directory exists to prevent.
`packages/ledger/test/integration/compaction-fixture.test.ts` rebuilds the fixture into a tmpdir on
every run and compares, so a change to what DeFlow writes fails there rather than silently leaving
the view held to a contract nothing produces.

Everything in here is synthetic: a fabricated run id, a fabricated node, and a demoted "build log"
that is one line of `q`s.
